test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper( Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At what rate percent per annum will the simple interest in 15 years on a sum of money be (3)/(4) of the sum invested?
solution:
**Concept used:**

SI = Principal × Rate% × Time × 1/100 

**Calculation:**

For SI to be 3/4 of sum invested, Let sum invested = Principal be 4x then SI = 3x [# choose accordingly as per given fraction]

Putting values, we get, 3x = 4x × Rate% × 15 × 1/100 

⇒ Rate% = 100 × 3 × 1/4 × 1/15

⇒ Rate% = 5%
